While the bull points to superior ROCE [E11] and ROE [E8] as justification for this premium, these returns do not bridge the -347.6% margin of safety gap [E32]. The claim that an EV/EBITDA of 0x [E10] signals an unrecognized structure is speculative, whereas the P/E of 103x [E1] and the P/B of 8.09x [E6] are concrete indicators of extreme overvaluation relative to sector benchmarks [E5, E6].
